next_step: Finish POC in UK region; perf validation + security signoff
notes:
Lead: CTO Samir Patel (ex-search engineer). Primary ask: low-latency embeddings + reranking across EU/UK with strict data residency for UK datasets.
Sizing: ~300M vectors (nightly batch updates), expected steady QPS 200-400; peak spikes to 1k for short windows. Target 95th pct latency < 60ms for combined embed+rerank path. Cost sensitivity: target < $0.005/query (embedding + rerank).
Current infra: Elastic + custom reranker; considering Redwood Dedicated in UK with EU failover. Must have SSO (SAML), SOC2, KMS, audit logs, and per-region billing attribution.
POC scope: ingest 10M test vectors, run A/B rerank comparison vs in-house model, perf + correctness evaluation for 30 days. POC success criteria: latency SLA met in UK region, rerank quality >= current baseline, cost model < target.
Security notes: Legal requires proof of residency for UK-labeled datasets; air-gap not required but strict network controls and VPC peering needed.
SE recommendations so far: test quantized model variants for rerank to hit cost targets, enable prefix caching for hot content, verify KV-cache behavior for multi-region hot keys, evaluate hybrid routing (UK-primary, EU-secondary) with automatic failover.
Open questions: support for quantized rerank models on Dedicated UK nodes, cross-region KV cache invalidation, cross-region fallbacks for model variants, and billing granularity per region.
Direct quote from call: "We can't leave PII outside the UK — that kills any alternative architecture." — Samir.
Next meetings: perf validation kickoff (12/07), legal/data residency check-in (12/20).
